name: Sentinel
bio: Archetype: Bloodtithe, Bullet, HP Burn, Extra Action. ⌽ Gains [Bloodtithe] when losing HP. All attacks are considered [Retribution], meaning that they scale with HP instead of ATK. ⌽ Skill 1 deals damage and applies [Fresh Wound] on self, which causes HP loss over time based on its count. ⌽ Skill 2 consumes [Bloodtithe] to grant [Dread Bullet]s to self and the ally directly in front. Auto-fires Skill 1 a few times every turn until out of [Dread Bullet]s. ⌽ [Dread Bullet] grants buffs to its holder and increases damage dealt based on max HP. ⌽ Chance to gain Moxie or [Fresh Wound] when using a bullet. ⌽ Ultimate consumes all [Fresh Wound] to increase damage, and heals self afterwards.
